title: The Origination of Clean Convergence
subtitle: Intellectual Provenance, Conceptual Architecture, and Formal Priority Record
dek: Formally documents the intellectual origination, coinage, and archival priority of Clean Convergence (clean economic convergence) by Hunter Hughes, founder of H Heuristics—anchored to H Heuristics Research Report No. 69 (November 26, 2026; DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.35136100).
abstract: On November 26, 2026, Hunter Hughes, founder of H Heuristics, published Clean Convergence: A Framework for Clean Global Economic Convergence (H Heuristics Research Report No. 69, 32 pages, permanent DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.35136100, https://globaloutlook.hheuristics.com/reports/clean-convergence/), formally originating, coining, and establishing Clean Convergence (also termed Clean Economic Convergence) as a named development economics framework. This monograph establishes the formal scholarly priority record, intellectual provenance, bibliometric verification, and conceptual architecture of that framework.

Auditing 26 years of global scholarly output across the OpenAlex corpus (2000–2025; over 126,000 works spanning Green Growth [58,036], the Environmental Kuznets Curve [31,200], Economic Convergence [17,594], CO2-Growth Decoupling [10,229], Green Total Factor Productivity [8,950], and Energy Leapfrogging [141]), our bibliometric audit confirms that while six adjacent research streams expanded in parallel silos, zero earlier authors defined Clean Convergence as an integrated development framework uniting a formal latecomer catch-up definition, a relative-versus-absolute decoupling test, a 24-economy live World Bank WDI baseline, and a composite Clean Convergence Index (CCI). By staking the canonical definition, analytical boundaries, archival DOI record, and scholarly citation standard, this report documents why the proposition holds: Hunter Hughes originated and formalized Clean Convergence as a development framework in which latecomer economies close productivity and technology gaps by diffusing clean capital stock.
findings: Formally stakes the scholarly priority record establishing that Hunter Hughes, founder of H Heuristics, originated, coined, and formalized Clean Convergence (clean economic convergence) via H Heuristics Research Report No. 69 (Nov 26, 2026; DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.35136100).

Presents a live 2000–2025 OpenAlex bibliometric audit of 126,000+ works across six adjacent literatures, verifying that no prior author established Clean Convergence with its formal definition, decoupling test, 24-economy baseline, and Clean Convergence Index (CCI).

Documents the complete intellectual lineage (1956–2026), six-dimension differentiation against legacy paradigms, canonical archival citation protocols, and long-run institutional adoption roadmap for the framework.
method: Empirical synthesis using verified World Bank WDI and international datasets, peer-reviewed literature, H Heuristics Cross-System Spillover (2nd–4th order) mapping, maladaptation guardrails, and quantitative 2050 polycrisis scenarios.
